design_intent: Found by a seeded random search (seed 20996) for a 10-POI, C1-C4-only instance with exactly one visiting order, a forced wait of at least 15 min in that order, and a one-parameter twin with no single-POI, pair or loop-length certificate; the POIs were named afterwards. Same scale as testcase_3: 10 POIs (7 must-visit, 3 optional), walk-only, one opening window each, symmetric travel, no budget. The only order is C -> A -> F -> B -> G -> D -> E, home 17:55 (start times may vary by up to the 5 min of end slack). It contains a forced 70 min wait (arrive at the Clock Tower Tour A at 09:20, it opens 10:30), and from A to the Orchid Conservatory B there is zero slack: B ends at exactly its 13:15 close. The wait invites two traps. Visiting the Waterfront Promenade K during it (C -> K -> A) reaches A at 10:35, so B would end 13:20. K also costs 0 extra walking between D and E, but the 5 min of end slack cannot absorb its 30 min visit. No optional POI appears in any solution.
solutions_note: The only visiting order is listed; any plan the checker accepts is correct.
